title: A Beckmann boundary form of Talagrand's conjecture on the discrete cube
summary: We introduce the Beckmann boundary of a Boolean function \[ \mathsf{B}(f)=\inf_{\operatorname{div} V=Lf}\mathbb E\|V(x)\|_2. \] Here \[ L=\sum_iD_i,\qquad D_i f(x)=\frac{f(x)-f(x^{\oplus i})}{2}, \] and $\operatorname{div} V(x)=\sum_i (V_{i}(x)-V_{i}(x^{\oplus i}))$. This nonlocal quantity is no larger than the usual two-sided, one-sided, colored, optimized colored, or optimized fractional colored boundaries. Nevertheless, every nonconstant Boolean $f$ satisfies \[ \mathsf{B}(f)\gtrsim \operatorname{Var}(f) \sqrt{\log\!\left(1+\frac{1}{\sum_i\operatorname{Inf}_i(f)^2}\right)}. \] We also…
